text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
How is everything, everyone? Are the sizes 
fitting all right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, p-please wait just a little longer~! 
The obi is... ugh, so difficult...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa! Urara-san, please hold still 
for just a second! 
We're almost done!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha-ha! Feast your eyes on my 
breathtaking elegance 
as I don my New Year's finest! A beauty 
not of this earth, like a celestial rose!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am the celebration itself! The herald of 
the New Year! 
Behold! Here and now, I proclaim the dawn 
of the New Overlord Kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I got mine on too! 
Huh? Opera-chan, yours looks a little 
different from mine?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since it's such a special outfit, I 
asked the designer to give each of you a 
slightly customized arrangement that suits 
your style♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Tazuna, completely 
thorough! By the way, how are the other 
two doing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, thanks for waiting~! 
The size, the fit, everything's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here! A flood of fortune! 
Auspicious yet dazzling! 
With this, Matikane "Fuku-kitaru" feels 
ready to blaze through a 3000m turf race 
and win with ease~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... Madam Chairwoman, was it really okay 
for you 
to have such wonderful outfits made for 
us~?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! When it comes to our students' 
endeavors, 
we spare no effort in providing full 
backing at all times!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume Karuta may look graceful, but in 
truth, it is fierce! 
Hence, these outfits are crafted using the 
very same materials as Racing Silks!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As representatives of this academy, I 
expect you to fight with everything you 
have!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-Madam Chairwoman... thank you so very 
much~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(In the past, I definitely would have felt 
crushed by that pressure... 
But now...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—In other words, they say a "Catcher" 
needs explosive speed, sharp reflexes, 
split-second judgment, and raw pace.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So... I think it's best if Opera O-san, 
with her outstanding late-stage burst, 
takes on that role.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all! Here you were, suddenly 
requesting a change in command, 
so I was expecting a dramatic coup d'état 
from Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-N-N-No way, far from it! 
A-And next, regarding Urara-san and 
Fukukitaru-san's pairing...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In Umamusume Karuta, disruptive roles like 
guards and screens are apparently very 
important too, um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
When the card to take is on our side, you 
guard against the opponent, and when it's 
on theirs, you draw their defense away to 
make a clear path for your teammate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So, Fukukitaru-san, if you could keep an 
eye on the opponents and give directions 
to Urara-san on how to move...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, my voice carries much better, and 
Urara-san seems like she could put up a 
tenacious guard!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And if that slows the opponents down even 
a little... Opera O-san won't... won't 
lose in a footrace!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, sorry! Someone like me... might just 
be saying weird, silly things...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Who knew there was such deep 
strategy to karuta? It's a real 
eye-opener~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to get really excited! Let's 
swap the taker and caller roles and give 
it a practice run!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's the matter, Doto-san? Is 
something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! I-It's just that putting on the 
outfit makes it feel like the real thing 
is finally here...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, indeed! Putting on your racing silks 
before a race really gets you fired up and 
focused!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All that's left now is to actually test 
out Doto-san's strategy, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for helping us 
out~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all! You guys are entering 
the tournament, right? That's so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: We're cheering for you, so do your best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aww, thank you very much. Well then, once 
the poem starts being read, please dash 
into our territory—

text_block_list.name: Text-to-Speech Voice
text_block_list.text: "—Umamusume, eternal—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-O-O-Opera O-san! Left side of our 
territory, row 5, card 1!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san, guard! Spread your arms out and 
block their way!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Got it! Like this!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alright—got it!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um... that just now... was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Truly ideal, truly elegant! It would not 
be an exaggeration to call that a flawless 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! My guard was super tight too, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was wondering how this would go at 
first... but that was amazing! Wasn't that 
just perfect?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And it's all thanks to Doto-san 
researching karuta for us! All hail 
General Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, n-no way! B-But still... if I could 
be even a little helpful, I'm... I'm so 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We worked super-duper hard, so I'm sure 
we're gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(I-It's true... practice is going well, so 
maybe, just maybe...? I thought it was 
completely out of our league, but... 
maybe...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, fortune in battle is fickle! 
Whatever the outcome, let's head into the 
tournament in this high spirit and seize 
New Year's good fortune together~!

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!
